identification: Box of about 20-25 modern cricket books, mostly hardcover with dust jackets: '200 Seasons of Australian Cricket' (ACB/Australian Cricket Board, large format), Gideon Haigh 'The Summer Game', Steve Waugh 'Never Say Die' (3 Jan 2003 Sydney Ashes hundred), Roland Perry 'Bradman's Best Ashes Teams', Geoffrey Boycott 'The Best XI', 'The Complete Who's Who of Test Cricketers', 'In Quest of the Ashes' (Jardine), Alan Border's Own Story, 'Cricket's Burning Passion', 'Peter the Lord's Cat and Other Unexpected Obituaries', Wisden-type volumes. Mostly 1980s-2000s mainstream titles, no early or scarce editions seen.
